WITH per_post AS (
  SELECT UserId, PostId, COUNT(*) AS history_count
  FROM postHistory
  WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY UserId, PostId
)
SELECT DISTINCT u.Id AS UserId
FROM users u
JOIN per_post pp ON pp.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Views >= 1000
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM per_post pp2

  )
ORDER BY u.Id
